report.title: Empty form submission does not require all fields
report.summary: The page does not prevent submission of an empty form, allowing a payment request to be sent. This is a critical security vulnerability.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Navigate to the Bill Pay page
2. Fill in none of the required fields
report.expected: The page should prevent submission of an empty form and display error messages for each missing field.
report.actual: A payment request was sent with an empty form.
evidence: Payee Name: Payee name is required.
Zip Code: Zip Code is required.
Verify Account #: Account number is required.
Amount: $ The amount cannot be empty.
report.suspected_cause: The page's validation logic is not correctly implemented.
report.next_action: The development team should review and fix the page's validation logic to prevent empty form submissions.
